hero.h1: UI UX design cost: what an agency charges and why
hero.sub: Published price ranges for every engagement we run, the 6 factors that move a quote up or down, and how to compare agency, freelance and in-house costs.

summary: Price ranges and cost factors for UI UX design projects and monthly design teams.
abstract: UI UX design cost at an agency ranges from $8,000 for an AI discovery workshop and $15,000 for a minimum viable product (MVP) design to $200,000 for a full SaaS product redesign, or $15,000 to $40,000 per month for a dedicated team. This guide from ui-ux.agency, the design team of tkxel, lists the user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) price ranges we quote and the 6 factors that set each price.

sections.h2: How much does UI UX design cost in 2026?
sections.answer: UI UX design cost at our agency starts at $8,000 for a discovery workshop and reaches $200,000 for a full platform redesign. The table lists the range for each engagement we run.
sections.caption: UI UX design cost by engagement at ui-ux.agency

sections.h2: Which factors change UI UX design cost?
sections.answer: 6 cost factors change UI UX design cost more than any other:

items.title: Number of user roles.
items.body: Each role, such as admin, buyer or seller, adds its own flows and screens.

items.title: Number of platforms.
items.body: Web, iOS and Android each need their own layouts and patterns.

items.title: Research depth.
items.body: Interviews, usability tests and analytics reviews add time and give stronger evidence.

items.title: Design system scope.
items.body: A full component library with tokens costs more upfront and saves engineering time later.

items.title: AI and data complexity.
items.body: AI output, dashboards and dense tables need more states and more testing.

items.title: Build support.
items.body: Designers who stay through development add weeks to the project and remove costly rework.

sections.h2: UI UX design cost: agency vs freelancer vs in-house
sections.answer: A freelancer usually has the lowest UI UX design cost per hour; an agency usually has the lowest cost per finished, tested product.

sections.h2: How do you lower UI UX design cost without cutting quality?
sections.answer: 4 decisions lower UI UX design cost while keeping research and testing in the project.

items.title: Start with one platform
items.body: Design web or mobile first, then adapt the tested flows to the second platform.

items.title: Limit the first release
items.body: A tight MVP scope keeps design focused on the flow users pay for.

items.title: Reuse a design system
items.body: Building on an open-source component library saves weeks of UI work.

items.title: Share research
items.body: Existing interviews, analytics and support tickets shorten discovery.

sections.h2: What does a UI UX design cost estimate include?
sections.answer: A UI UX design cost estimate from us follows 3 steps, from the first call to a written, fixed-scope proposal.

items.title: Scoping call
items.body: A 45-minute call about goals, users, platforms, deadlines and existing design work.

items.title: Written proposal
items.body: Scope, deliverables, team, timeline and a fixed price or monthly rate.

items.title: Review and adjust
items.body: We change scope or phasing until the plan fits your budget and launch date.

sections.answer: Answers to the most common questions about UI UX design cost.

faqs.q: How do you charge: fixed prices or hourly rates?
faqs.a: Fixed prices for projects with a clear scope, and a monthly rate when you hire UI UX designers as a dedicated team.

faqs.q: Why do UI UX design cost quotes differ so much between agencies?
faqs.a: Quotes differ because scope differs. Compare how many user roles, platforms, research sessions and test rounds each quote covers, and whether designers stay through development.

faqs.q: Does the UI UX design cost include development?
faqs.a: No. Design and development are quoted separately; tkxel's engineering team quotes the build when you need it.
